title: ThreeBody
description: In Minecraft, a high-freedom sandbox game brimming with endless possibilities, step into that vast and mysterious universe and immerse yourself in a world of The Three-Body Problem, filled with unknowns and dangers!
body:
# ThreeBody·三体
## Era of Perpetual Chaos
-  Alternation of the Era of Perpetual Chaos
## Catastrophes
- Single-Day Eclipse
- Double-Day Eclipse
- Triple-Day Eclipse
- Three Flying Stars
- The Great Rift
## Dark Forest Strike
### Exposure Value
Defines the exposure value. Destroying or placing blocks: +0.01; placing light sources: +0.02; global chat: +0.02 * number of characters in the message; other player-caused events: +0.005; the Age of Chaos automatically increases the value slowly: +0.001 per second;
### Dark Forest Strike
- Light Particles: Generates a level 100 explosion under all players’ feet;
- Two-Dimensional Foil: Clears all blocks at coordinates (x, y, z) where !(x==0||y==0||z==0).

## Dehydration
Use the /dehydrate command to drain water; after dehydration, the player enters spectator mode, remains fixed at the location where dehydration occurred, is granted the Blind effect, and is removed from the game upon re-immersion.
## Death
### The player’s IP is automatically banned upon death. 
## This plugin is available exclusively on Modrinth; if you find it anywhere else, it is not the official version.

***

- 单日凌空

## 黑暗森林打击
### 暴露值
定义暴露值。破坏、放置方块 +0.01，放置光源 +0.02，公屏聊天 +聊天的字数*0.5，其他由玩家造成的事件+0.005，乱纪元自动缓慢增加：每秒+0.001；
### 黑暗森林打击
- 光粒：在所有玩家的脚下产生100级爆炸；
- 二向箔：清除所有坐标(x,y,z)中 !(x==0||y==0||z==0) 的方块。

## 脱水
使用/dehydrate指令拖水；脱水后玩家变为旁观模式，位置固定于脱水时的位置，给于玩家失明效果，并在浸泡后清除。
## 死亡
### 玩家死亡后自动封禁IP。 

## 该插件仅在Modrinth提供，如果您在其他任何地方找到它，那都不是官方版本。
